title: Everything you want see and experience !
text:
I always wanted to go to a medieval old town with castle like structures and roads . Girona is just that . We went inside the church which was massive . The town is amazing . Great for pics and learning . Costa Bravo felt like we were in Santorini. Amazing restaurants and scenery. Bring your bathing suit.

author: Clerison_D

title: Personal Touch
text:
We went out with Stefan for a great visit to a traditional wine maker and farm house before a trip to the beach and then Tossa de Mar. Stefan was superb, having a wide range of knowledge about the local area, wildlife and culture.

I'd recommend this trip to those wanting to escape Barcelona and see a more rural and laid back view of the Costa Brava.
author: Nathan_S
